m2_s_fuses.speaker: havoc
takes: Oh, and your train is dead, by the way! Somebody pulled the emergency fuses on the platform. Three boxes, red lights. Flip them all, and it wakes up!

m2_s_fuel.speaker: ghost
takes: That train is dry. Fuel canisters stand about the station. Workshop, depot, both ends of the platform. Three will do.

m2_s_ready.speaker: phantom
takes: And before you ask: the train is fuelled and powered. We had time while you were busy in the villa. You are welcome.

m2_power_fuses.speaker: coleman
takes: The train is coming up on emergency power, Fireteam. Keep all three fuses on, and hold the platform until it is ready.

m2_power_fuel.speaker: coleman
takes: The train is coming up, but it will not leave on an empty tank. Three canisters, Fireteam. Hold the platform while you fill it.

m2_power_ready.speaker: coleman
takes: The train is pulling out of the siding. A few seconds, and then you are aboard. Do not get comfortable.

m2_fuse_trip.speaker: coleman
takes: One of the fuses just blew. Get it back in, or that train crawls.

m2_fuel_short.speaker: coleman
takes: The train is up, and the tank is not. Get the fuel in, Fireteam.

m2_r_phantom.speaker: phantom
takes: Phantom here. The tunnel behind you is ours. Get on that train. We will take care of the rest.

m2_r_havoc.speaker: havoc
takes: Havoc here! Whatever crawls out of that tunnel meets me first! Go, go, we have got this!

m2_r_ghost.speaker: ghost
takes: Ghost. The relay is clean, the platform is covered. Board the train.

m2_r_viper.speaker: viper
takes: Viper here. We have the platform. Board the train, we will take care of the rest. Do not look back.

m2_r_scorpion.speaker: scorpion
takes: Scorpion here! The platform is ours. Go, get on that train, I will keep the welcome party busy!

m2_r_raven.speaker: raven
takes: Raven. The platform is held. Get in the train. We handle the rest.

m2_d_phantom.speaker: phantom
takes: One of us goes with you. Me, naturally. The other two can mind the tunnel.

m2_d_havoc.speaker: havoc
takes: One of us comes along, and I call it! Me! The other two can babysit the tunnel!

m2_d_ghost.speaker: ghost
takes: One of us goes with you. I will. Two are enough for a tunnel.

m2_d_coleman.speaker: coleman
takes: One of theirs and one of ours. I can live with that. Whoever stays, that platform is your way home.

viper: Three boxes. Split up, and watch each other's backs.
scorpion: Flip a switch, wake the dead. What could possibly go wrong?
raven: Every switch will be heard. Be ready when it is.

viper: Fuel run. One carries, the others cover.
scorpion: Hauling gas cans through a station full of zombies. Living the dream.
raven: Three cans. Quickly, before more of them come.

viper: Then we do not waste it. Get to the control room.
scorpion: Wait. They did us a favour? I do not trust it.
raven: A gift from Helix hunters. Check it for wires.

viper: Fuse is out! Who is closest?
scorpion: The light went red again! Somebody kick that box!

viper: Then I hold here. Go with them, and go quickly. We have no time to argue.
scorpion: So I am the one babysitting the platform. Fine. Go on, go, before I change my mind!
raven: I stay. Go with them. Fast. Every minute we stand here is hers.

viper: Hold the platform. We will need that train to get back.
scorpion: Keep the lights on for us. And do not get eaten, I still owe you money.
raven: Hold it. I am not walking home.
